title: Warnings from Israel's History, Do All to the Glory of God

questions.question: Paul reminds them that their fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea, and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea, and all ate the same ____ food.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:1-3 (ESV): "For I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud... and all ate the same spiritual food,"

questions.question: And all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual Rock that followed them, and the Rock was ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:4 (ESV): "and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual Rock that followed them, and the Rock was Christ."

questions.question: Nevertheless, with most of them God was not pleased, for they were ____ in the wilderness.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:5 (ESV): "Nevertheless, with most of them God was not pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness."

questions.question: Now these things took place as examples for us, that we might not desire ____ as they did.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:6 (ESV): "Now these things took place as examples for us, that we might not desire evil as they did."

questions.question: Paul warns against idolatry, sexual immorality, putting Christ to the test, and grumbling. How many fell in a single day because of sexual immorality?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:8 (ESV): "We must not indulge in sexual immorality as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in a single day."

questions.question: We must not put Christ to the test, as some of them did and were destroyed by ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:9 (ESV): "We must not put Christ to the test, as some of them did and were destroyed by serpents,"

questions.question: nor grumble, as some of them did and were destroyed by the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:10 (ESV): "nor grumble, as some of them did and were destroyed by the Destroyer."

questions.question: Now these things happened to them as an example, but they were written down for our instruction, on whom the ____ of the ages has come.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:11 (ESV): "Now these things happened to them as an example, but they were written down for our instruction, on whom the end of the ages has come."

questions.question: Therefore let anyone who thinks that he stands take heed lest he ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:12 (ESV): "Therefore let anyone who thinks that he stands take heed lest he fall."

questions.question: No temptation has overtaken you that is not common to man. God is faithful, and he will not let you be tempted beyond your ability, but with the temptation he will also provide the ____, that you may be able to endure it.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:13 (ESV): "...but with the temptation he will also provide the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it."

questions.question: The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a participation in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a participation in the body of Christ? Because there is one bread, we who are many are ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:16-17 (ESV): "...Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread."

questions.question: Paul warns that what pagans sacrifice, they offer to ____ and not to God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:20 (ESV): "No, I imply that what pagans sacrifice they offer to demons and not to God. I do not want you to be participants with demons."

questions.question: "All things are lawful," but not all things are helpful. "All things are lawful," but not all things ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:23 (ESV): "'All things are lawful,' but not all things are helpful. 'All things are lawful,' but not all things build up."

questions.question: Let no one seek his own good, but the good of his ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:24 (ESV): "Let no one seek his own good, but the good of his neighbor."

questions.question: So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 10:31 (ESV): "So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God."

key_verse_text: No temptation has overtaken you that is not common to man. God is faithful, and he will not let you be tempted beyond your ability, but with the temptation he will also provide the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
